El venezolano George Wittels diseña la nueva corona del Miss Universo para su 75.ª edición

La Organización Miss Universo presentó la nueva corona oficial de la 75.ª edición del certamen, titulada «The Radiance of an Eternal Legacy» («El resplandor de un legado eterno»), diseñada por el joyero venezolano George Wittels en colaboración con la casa parisina Maison d'OR, según el anuncio de la organización y crónicas de Philstar y The Inquirer.

La pieza, de oro blanco de 18 quilates y 3.150 diamantes, fue develada el 12 de noviembre en San Juan, Puerto Rico, durante The Miss Universe Experience en Plaza Las Américas. El director ejecutivo de Miss Universo, Ronald Day, la describió como un homenaje a la historia del certamen y a las mujeres que han llevado el título. La final está prevista para el 24 de noviembre en el Coliseo de Puerto Rico.

Wittels, de acuerdo con The Inquirer, también ha diseñado coronas del Miss Grand International y del Miss Supranational.

It begins with John Dee at the court of Elizabeth I, where his attempts to communicate with angels accidentally open a doorway through time. But the beings he contacts aren’t angels sent by God. They’re fallen angels, presenting themselves as divine or advanced intelligences and offering forbidden knowledge.

That knowledge passes through the centuries, influencing Nikola Tesla’s discoveries, Nazi occult experiments, and eventually secret programs operating within intelligence agencies and military black projects. These organizations supposedly communicate with the same entities through séances, occult rituals, sacrifices, and increasingly advanced technology, receiving scientific knowledge in exchange for cooperation.

The Nazis attempt to use this knowledge to develop advanced weapons, portals, and time travel, with the Holy Lance—the spear that pierced Christ at the Crucifixion—playing a central role. Their surviving Antarctic operations are eventually encountered by Admiral Byrd’s expedition. The entities are actually fallen angels who hate God and hate mankind because we were created in His image. They rejected God and cannot share in the eternal communion with Him that humanity is offered. So their mission is to deceive us into rejecting that destiny ourselves.

They do this by manipulating civilizations, religions, governments, scientific development, and human behavior. They encourage division, hatred, fear, materialism, spiritual confusion, and self-destruction, while disguising their influence as enlightenment, progress, or contact with superior beings.

That’s why Christ and the Crucifixion are at the center of everything. His sacrifice opened the way for humanity’s salvation, and the fallen angels are doing everything they can to turn us away from it.

Their goal isn’t necessarily to destroy humanity physically. It’s to corrupt us spiritually. To make us smaller, more fearful, more divided, and more consumed by hatred and power, instead of expanding in love, consciousness, creativity, and communion with God.

In other words, humanity was created to reflect God’s love and carry that goodness outward into creation, potentially even across the cosmos. The fallen angels want to prevent that by convincing us to destroy ourselves or willingly surrender the very things that make us human.

So the entire conspiracy—from John Dee and Tesla to Nazi occultism, Antarctic mysteries, UAPs, and modern intelligence agencies—is really one long campaign of spiritual deception.

The technology is the bait. Humanity is the target. And our eternal separation from God is the objective.
